physicsw.missingLimits: The %(kind)s limits are incomplete; no range was inferred.
physicsw.missingFrame: A supported node frame is unavailable for %(name)s; world geometry is withheld.
physicsw.angularRevolution: An angular range exceeds one revolution; its arc is withheld.
physicsw.kind: Choose FSMP XML or CBPC TXT.
physicsw.size: The physics document exceeds the configured input or numeric-field limit.
physicsw.nonfinite: A nonfinite source number is preserved but cannot be edited or evaluated.
physicsw.entities: DTD and entity declarations are not supported.
physicsw.inheritance: Defaults or inheritance are present. Their effective values are unresolved, so ranges are withheld.
physicsw.nominal: Nominal configured limits at the supplied rest node frames. This is no solver or motion prediction; angular arcs are visual glyphs in radians.
physicsw.lastWins: Repeated limit or frame tags use the last source occurrence.
physicsw.unsupportedFrame: This joint frame uses unsupported semantics; world geometry is withheld.
physicsw.unsupportedConstraint: This constraint type or XML namespace is unsupported; its numeric settings are preserved without a range preview.
physicsw.cbpcRaw: Raw CBPC settings only. Offset clamps are not final displacement or direct angles. Weight interpolation, linear/rotation factors, forces, collision response and provider behavior are not evaluated.
